spans.s:
धृष् धृष्, cl. 1. 5. P. धर्षति, धृष्-
णोति, दधर्ष (part. दधृष्वस्),
धर्षिष्यति, अधर्षीत् (Vedic forms दधर्-
षीत्, दधर्षत्, दधर्षति), धर्षितुम्, to
be bold or courageous; to be confident or presump-
tuous, to be proud or overbearing; to be impudent
or impatient; to have courage to do anything, to
dare, venture (with inf., e. g. धृष्णुमः प्रष्-
टुम्, we dare to ask); to dare to attack, &c. (with
acc. of the person); to insult, overbear, treat with
indignity: Pass. धृष्यते, to be attacked or in-
sulted, to be subdued or overpowered: Caus. धर्-
षयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अदधर्षत् or अदीधृषत्,
to dare to attack, to overbear, insult, treat with indig-
nity, violate (a woman); offend, injure; assail, over-
power, overcome, conquer, destroy; (A.) to surpass (?):
[]
Desid. दिधर्षिषति: Intens. दरीधृष्यते,
दरीधर्ष्टि; [cf. Zend daresh, ‘to dare;’ darshi,
‘strong:’ Gr. θρασ-ύ-ς, θράσ-ος, θάρσ-ος, θαρσ-έ-ω,
θαῤῥέω, θαρσ-ύνω, Θερσ-ίτη-ς: Lat. fortis: Goth.
ga-daurs-an, ‘to dare:’ Slav. drĭz-a-ti, drĭz-na-ti,
‘to dare:’ Lith. dras-ù-s, ‘courageous;’ dras-à,
‘courage:’ Hib. das-ached, ‘fierceness.’]

धृषज्, क्, क्, क् (?) , Ved. assailing, attacking,
destroying.

धृषत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, pres. part., Ved. bold,
daring, courageous, confident; (अता), ind. boldly,
courageously.
—धृषद्-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
of a brave race, heroic.
—धृषद्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ,
Ved. bold, courageous.
—धृषन्-मनस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, Ved. brave-hearted.
धृषित, अस्, आ, अम्, bold, courageous, brave, daring.

धृषु, उस्, उस्, उ, bold, proud; clever; (उस्),
m. a heap, multitude.

धृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, bold, daring, courageous,
confident; insolent, impudent, rude, saucy, shame-
less; forward, intrusive, presumptuous; profligate,
abandoned; obtained?; (अस्), m. a faithless hus-
band; N. of a son of Manu Vaivasvata, (also read
धृष्णु; cf. धार्ष्ट); of a son of Kunti; of a
son of Bhajamāna; (अस्), m., N. of a spell for using
or restraining magical weapons; (आ), f. a disloyal or
unchaste woman; (अम्), ind. boldly, courageously,
fearlessly; (it is said that धृष्ट may be used at the
end of a comp. to give a bad sense to the word with
which it is compounded); [cf. Angl. Sax. thriste;
Swed. dristig; Old Iceland. dreiss; Mod. Germ.
dreist.]
—धृष्ट-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a king of
Cedi; of a king of Videhā or Mithilā, son of Su-
dhṛti; of a son of Satya-dhṛti; of a son of Su-
kumāra; of the father of Su-kumāra; of a son of
Dhṛṣṭa-dyumna; of a king of the Kaikayas; of a
son of Manu.
—धृष्ट-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, very
bold or daring, most confident or courageous.
—धृष्ट-ता, f. or धृष्ट-त्व, अम्, n. bold-
ness, courage, impudence.
—धृष्ट-द्युम्न, अस्,
m., N. of a son of Dru-pada (killed by Aśvatthāman
while asleep).
—धृष्ट-धी, ईस्, or धृष्ट-
बुद्धि, इस्, m. ‘bold-minded,’ N. of a man.
—धृष्ट-पराक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, of daring
valour.
—धृष्ट-मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a high
opinion of one's self.
—धृष्ट-रथ, अस्, m., N.
of a prince.
—धृष्ट-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a
son of Śvaphalka.
—धृष्टोक्त (˚ट-उक्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a son of Arjuna Kārttavīrya; (also read
धृष्णोक्त.)
धृष्टक, अस्, m., N. of a prince.

धृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (according to Mahī-
dhara) bold; (इस्), m. a pair of tongs; N. of a son
of Hiraṇya-kaśipu; of a minister of king Daśa-ratha;
(इस्), f. boldness.

धृष्ण, अस्, &c., a wrong reading for धृष्ट,
q. v.
—धृष्णोक्त (˚ण-उक्˚), अस्, &c., a wrong
reading for धृष्टोक्त, q. v.

धृष्णज्, क्, क्, क्, bold, confident; impudent,
shameless.
धृष्णि, इस्, m. a ray of light.

धृष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, courageous, bold, confident,
valiant; impudent, shameless; strong, powerful,
(applied in the Veda to Indra, Soma, the Maruts,
and the horses of Indra); (उ), ind. in a bold or
confident or powerful way; firmly, strongly; with
force [cf. दधृक्]; (उस्), m., N. of a son of
Manu Vaivasvata [cf. धृष्ट]; of a son of Manu
Sāvarṇa; of a son of Kavi; of a son of Ku-
kura; कश्यपस्य धृष्णु, N. of a Sāman.
—धृष्णु-त्व, अम्, n. boldness, confidence.
—धृष्णु-षेण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having an
overpowering weapon; (Sāy.) having a conquering
or overpowering host, leading a valiant army (as a
drum).
—धृष्ण्व्-ओजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of over-
powering strength, endowed with resistless might,
(applied to Indra and the Maruts.)

धृष्णुक, अस्, m., N. of a prince; [cf. धृष्-
टक.]

धृष्णुया, ind., Ved. in a bold or powerful
manner, firmly.

धृष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, assailable, to be attacked;
conquerable.
धृषद् धृषद्, Ved. = दृषद्, q. v.
